articleUrl.title: Article URL
articleUrl.description: A public HTTPS article to investigate. Leave blank for automatic current-news discovery.

claim.title: Headline or claim
claim.description: Search for reporting and original sources about a claim. The Actor does not declare truth.

queries.title: Custom discovery queries
queries.description: Up to three search queries. Overrides the article URL, claim and built-in topic lanes.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: At most three queries and four original-evidence investigations.

investigate.title: Follow original-evidence leads
investigate.description: Retrieve sources linked in the reporting, then use bounded original-source searches where necessary.

date.title: Edition date
date.description: Optional exact historical publication day, YYYY-MM-DD. Ignored if explicit queries, claim or article URL are supplied.
